products.title: The Double-Ended Eyeshadow Brush
products.body_html:
The only brush you need for every look you want to create. We know how intimidating  eyeshadow can be, so we created a brush that uncomplicates the application. The larger end of the brush (Blend) is designed to mimic the ease of using your fingers but with more precision and control. The smaller side of the brush (Define) is perfect for more detailed shadow application, from lining and smudging the lash lines to highlighting the inner corner and brow bone.

Made with luxurious vegan bristles that always pick up just the right amount of product, so you don’t have to think about it. Again, it’s all about ease.

products.title: SuperSuede™ Baked Eyeshadow
products.body_html:
Introducing eyeshadow, simplified— SuperSuede™ Baked Eyeshadow is the uncomplicated shadow you’ll reach for every day. Each single sweeps on seamlessly and diffuses instantly for a suede-like veil of dimension that lasts up to 16 hours— no primer needed*. In modern neutral shades with demi-matte and low-lit shimmer finishes, wear one shade alone or layer multiple for a soft, dimensional eye look. SuperSuede™ Baked Eyeshadow wears all day without creasing, smudging, fading, or patchiness.** It’s also cruelty free, vegan, and talc free.

*In a clinical study.

**In a consumer study of 30 women aged 18–60, both immediately and after 8 hours of product use.

CitySet™ is non-comedogenic, alcohol- and scent-free. It’s also dermatologist tested to be safe for all skin types including sensitive, blemish-prone, and dry skin.

products.title: Slip Tint™ Undetectable Baked Setting Powder
products.body_html:

This lightweight, creamy baked powder delivers a natural-radiant finish while leaving no visible trace on the skin. Developed with innovative Baked by Saie technology, Slip Tint™ Setting Powder is packed with clean, nourishing ingredients like Phytosqualane and Silica that smooth and blur fine lines.  Slip Tint™ Setting Powder also absorbs excess oil and shine without looking cakey, settling into pores/fine lines, or emphasizing texture.

Available in 5 translucent shades suitable for a wide range of skin types and tones. All shades are translucent on skin and appear lighter in the pan.

Slip Tint™ Baked Setting Powder is Non-Comedogenic, Safe for Sensitive & Blemish-Prone Skin. Dermatologist Tested & Fragrance-Free. Non-Irritating & Non-Drying.

products.title: The SuperSuede™ Stack
products.body_html: Thoughtfully designed to pair seamlessly together, SuperSuede™ Baked Powder Blush and The Powder Blush Brush are the perfect duo for a diffused flush of color. Start by dipping the flat side of The Powder Blush Brush into SuperSuede™. Gently tap off excess pigment from bristles for a controlled, even application. Finish by softly sweeping brush over apples of the cheeks and up toward the temples. Repeat to build pigment.

products.title: The Powder Blush Brush
products.body_html:
This sleek brush is thoughtfully designed to pair seamlessly with SuperSuede™ Baked Powder Blush. Its oval brush tip is tapered on each side which allows for easy product pickup and diffused application onto cheeks, without any fall out or mess. The slender 100% aluminum handle allows for a delicate, paintbrush-like hold. All Saie brushes are effortless to use, perfect for travel, and made to last.  

All Saie brushes are VEGAN, have CRUELTY-FREE SYNTHETIC BRISTLES and a 100% ALUMINUM HANDLE and are made in a LEED and EcoVadis SILVER CERTIFIED* FACILITY. 

Pro tip: Use one side of the bristles to pick up product and the other clean side to diffuse and blend out seams.

products.title: SuperSuede™ Baked Powder Blush
products.body_html:
Super luxurious and super plush, SuperSuede™ Baked Powder Blush is the new standard for baked powder blush. Hand-whipped and baked using time-honored Italian techniques, SuperSuede™ has a velvety texture that melts into skin for an impossibly lightweight, diffused flush of color with a natural-blurred finish. With a curated palette of six shades, SuperSuede™ Blush gives effortless, breathable color payoff, and works for a wide range of looks. SuperSuede™ is also non-comedogenic, long-wearing, and never patchy, cakey, or drying.

Pair with NEW: The Powder Blush Brush, intentionally designed for SuperSuede™ for precise, seamless application.  

We recommend keeping SuperSuede™ out of direct lighting, both natural and artificial, when not in use. Since this formula contains some light-sensitive pigments, excess light may affect the top layer. Simply dust off the top layer to return to normal.

products.title: The Dew-O
products.body_html: For the ultimate bronzy flush any time of year, stack these two effortless cheek essentials. With their chunky doe-foot applicators and blendable liquid-cream formulas, Dew Blush™ and Dew Bronze™ work together to create a dewy, wash of color and subtly defined bronze.

products.title: The Slip Tint™ Family
products.body_html: Your effortless, multi-tasking must-haves for nourished skin and a glowing no-makeup, makeup look. Stack together for The Signature SaieGlow™.

products.title: The Brush Collection
products.body_html:
The complete collection of our luxury brushes. Each Saie brush is meticulously crafted to make all the difference in your beauty routine. Here is how we like to use them but they are designed to be multi-use. 

THE BASE BRUSH for precise blending and a diffused base. Perfect for liquid creams like Dew Bronze™ and Glowy Super Skin Tint Foundation.

THE BIG BRUSH for all-over buffing and blending. Perfect for creams, gels, and balms like Glowy Super Gel™, Slip Tint™ Tinted Moisturizer and Sun Melt™.

THE DOUBLE BRUSH for sculpting, concealing, and blending. The small end is for precise highlight application or concealer while the large end works for sculpting and blush. Perfect for liquid and cream products like Slip Tint™ Concealer, Dew Blush™, and Glow Sculpt™.

THE FLUFFY BRUSH for targeted powder application. Perfect for powder and cream products like Airset™ and Dew Blush™.

THE POWDER BLUSH BRUSH for diffused powder blush application. Perfect for baked powder blushes like SuperSuede™ Baked Powder Blush.

THE ALL-OVER POWDER BLUSH for all-over powder application. Perfect for baked powders like Slip Tint™ Setting Powder.  

All Saie brushes are VEGAN, have CRUELTY-FREE SYNTHETIC BRISTLES with a 100% ALUMINUM HANDLE and are made in a LEED and EcoVadis SILVER CERTIFIED* FACILITY.

products.title: The Allure Bundle 2024
products.body_html: In a sea of products, these Saie essentials made it into the ranks of beauty’s most prestigious award: Allure’s Best of Beauty. Start with Glowy Super Gel as your first step and the easiest way to glow. Add on Glow Sculpt as your multi-use radiant blush, lifting bronzer, and blushy highlighter. Finish with Sun Melt, the ultimate fool-proof bronzer for an effortless all-over bronze. That’s an award-winning SaieGlow™!

products.title: Lip Liner 101™
products.body_html:
Rethink everything you know about lip liner. Saie hello to Lip Liner 101™, the most foolproof, confusion free, and nourishing lip liner that makes it effortless to enhance your natural lip shape. The luxuriously creamy, soft matte formula glides on smoothly for a naturally framed or fully filled look with no tugging, tightness, feathering, or dryness—all in an elegantly understated, classic wooden pencil that minimizes excess packaging. Lip Liner 101™ comes in five versatile neutral shades that stack perfectly with your favorite gloss – like Glossybounce™ – for a timeless lip combo.

Powered by Saie Science, Lip Liner 101™’s formula is supercharged with Shea Butter, Jojoba Oil and Meadowfoam Oil for a comfortable, nourishing essential. Lip Liner 101™ is vegan, cruelty free and safe for sensitive skin.

products.title: Dew Bronze™
products.body_html:
Bronze but better! Saie hello to Dew Bronze™, the most effortless liquid bronzer for a subtly defined bronze with a soft-focus finish. Dew Bronze™’s chunky doe-foot applicator is designed for fool-proof targeted application to create subtle definition or an all-over bronze. Its lightweight, blendable formula melts into skin and gives a seamless flush of bronzed color that’s never streaky, cakey or orange.

We did the work to give you a nourishing, year-long tan. Powered by Saie Science, Dew Bronze™ is packed with Plant-Derived Glycerin for plumping, Licorice Root Extract for brightening, and Silica for blurring. Available in 6 shades that range from cool to warm undertones.

products.title: Slip Tint Radiant All-Over Concealer
products.body_html:
Saie hello to Slip Tint Radiant All-Over Concealer, your multi-tasking essential for instant skin confidence. Slip Tint Concealer has medium coverage that undetectably conceals imperfections, from redness to dark circles, and wears for up to 12 hours. Its lightweight, cream formula melts into skin for the freshest, most natural-radiant finish.  

We’ve done the work so you can feel confident applying this effortless, non-comedogenic concealer, knowing it will care for your skin in the moment and over time. Based on a clinical and consumer perception study, Slip Tint Concealer has been proven to minimize pore size, smooth skin, and improve the appearance of blemishes and fine lines while never caking, creasing or looking greasy throughout the day.*

Powered by Saie Science, Slip Tint’s formula is supercharged with soothing Niacinamide, hydrating Hyaluronic Acid and plumping Plant-Derived Glycerin. Stack effortlessly with Slip Tint Tinted Moisturizer and all of our essentials for The Signature SaieGlow™. Slip Tint Concealer is also dermatologist tested, sensitive-skin friendly, ophthalmologist tested** and vegan. 

*Based on a clinical and consumer perception study.

In a clinical and consumer perception study over 4 weeks, 32 women ages 39-69 agreed: 

  • 100% of subjects had minimization of pore size at 2 and 4 weeks.*

  • 100% of subjects had improvement in the appearance of fine lines and crows feet at 2 and 4 weeks.*

  • 97%  agreed it did not settle or crease throughout the day, was crease resistant, and did not crack or cling to patches on skin after application and/or throughout the day.**

*Clinical Evaluation 

**Consumer Perception

products.title: The Fluffy Brush
products.body_html: We designed the Fluffy Brush to be first-time-powder-person friendly. It’s palm-sized and with a pinpointed tip that allows you to precisely tap powders on targeted areas while the soft fluffy bristles give you all over airy application.

products.title: Glossybounce™
products.body_html:
The slip of a lip oil meets the high-shine of a tinted gloss. Glossybounce™ is our best-selling, high-shine lip gloss-oil hybrid with a plush, cushiony feel that’s never sticky or tacky. This long-lasting, vegan lip essential is supercharged with nourishing, hydrating ingredients for soft lips and your juiciest shine ever!Available in nine sheer shades and three shimmer shades. Get a Glossybounce™ for every bag!

Glossybounce™ is formulated without natural or synthetic fragrance and with a touch of natural stevia for taste. You may notice the scent of raw ingredients but this fades quickly after application.

products.title: The Double Brush
products.body_html:
Our dual purpose Double Brush is designed to highlight, sculpt, and conceal. The Double Brush features a large end for sculpting the high points of the face and a small end to highlight and conceal smaller areas like eyelids and under eyes for more precise application. This brush is the perfect companion to Slip Tint™ Concealer, Glow Sculpt™, and Dew Blush™! 

Made with ultra-soft vegan bristles to disperse product flawlessly.

products.title: Glow Sculpt™
products.body_html: The flush of blush meets a radiant glow. Glow Sculpt™ is a creamy, tinted highlighter that gives an unparalleled “lifted” effect that’s never chalky or glittery. Its lightweight formula moisturizes and nourishes skin while diffused cream pigments blend with fine micropearl to create the ultimate multi-tasking SaieGlow™ essential. Going for a glowy blush? Seeking out a sculpting highlighter? Get ready for the Glow Sculpt™ effect. Finished your Glow Sculpt™? Glow forth with our refillable compact! When you’re done, pop out the old shade pan and replace with a glowy, new one. Our 100% plastic-free shade pans help us reduce single-use plastic and help you keep on glowing. Win-win! By choosing to refill you’re saving one less compact from landfills and supporting innovation in beauty sustainability! 🌱

products.title: The Base Brush
products.body_html: Our cruelty-free foundation brush is made with ultra-soft synthetic bristles and has a unique surface that disperses product seamlessly without waste. This brush is the perfect companion to Dew Bronze™ and Glowy Super™ Skin Tint Foundation.

products.title: Glowy Super Skin Tint Foundation
products.body_html:
85% skincare serum, 15% weightless pigment for 100% your best skin ever. Our lightweight skin tint foundation provides skincare benefits, medium coverage and a luminous, second-skin finish. Press in this lightweight serum formula like you would your skincare serum to get all the benefits of Glowy Super Skin’s supercharged ingredients like Hyaluronic Acid and Rice Bran Peptides for visibly plumper, more hydrated, and brighter skin. So weightless and breathable that you’ll forget you’re wearing foundation at all.

85% SUPERCHARGED INGREDIENTS:

Hyaluronic Acid - Attracts and binds moisture to smooth and hydrate skin

Rice Bran Peptides - Reduces the appearance of fine lines, pore, helps fade dark spots brightening skin tone.

Polyglutamic Acid - Hydrates the skin while locking in moisture to soften the appearance of fine lines, pores and plump the skin.

Glycerin - A powerful humectant known to increase skin’s natural moisture level.

products.title: Mini Sunvisor™
products.body_html: Super clean SPF protection that fits in your pocket! Our radiant and moisturizing SPF 35 sunscreen is now available as a mini! Our skincare-packed formula is sheer and absorbs easily with clean, 100% Mineral Non-Nano Zinc Oxide SPF 35 to protect against UVA/UVB rays and free radical damage. Active levels of encapsulated Vitamin C help to brighten the appearance of skin and protect against free radicals while Hyaluronic Acid, Vitamin E and Aloe Vera hydrate and nourish for dewy, moisturized, and sun-protected skin.

products.title: Airset
products.body_html:
Set, smooth, and diffuse with our unbelievably weightless and radiant loose powder. Airset™’s patented aerated-cream technology provides a natural, velvety finish with a Signature SaieGlow™.  Our formula is complete with hydrating Squalane, which deeply moisturizes skin and leaves it plump and smooth, and ethically-sourced Mica for luminous, supple skin that’s never cakey or dry.

Using The Fluffy Brush, tap onto targeted areas to blur and remove shine, or use a small amount all over for a your-skin-but-better effect.
